why:
THE META ANSWERED EVERY COST drain-v2 PAID, AND THE ANSWERS ARE ALREADY IN A BOX. Moxfield is Cloudflare-blocked to every route tried, so this is EDHREC's aggregate over ~6,703 Zur, Eternal Schemer decks rather than a handful of individual lists -- which is the better sample for a benchmark anyway. Read as a ranking, not as a verdict: EDHREC truncates each section at its top 50, so a card absent from it is UNRANKED and not unplayed.

THE SINGLE MOST-INCLUDED CARD THIS DECK LACKED IS MESA ENCHANTRESS AT 72.6%, synergy +0.64, and it is the direct answer to the one real cost drain-v2 paid: extra cards by turn eight fell 2.43 -> 1.53. 'Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, you may draw a card' in a list of 44 enchantments is the fix the meta already found, and it is the only enchantress in this colour identity.

STARFIELD MYSTIC (61.8%, syn +0.55) ANSWERS THE CURVE TAX. drain-v2 bought its result by taking average mana value 2.667 -> 2.905, and drain-v3 tried to pay that back with cheaper cards and measured WORSE on every axis. 'Enchantment spells you cast cost {1} less' pays it back without cutting anything, and it is redundancy on Inquisitive Glimmer, which the deck already runs and which the same measurement says is not enough on its own.

SIGIL OF THE EMPTY THRONE (48.2%, syn +0.43) REPLACES A WORSE VERSION OF ITSELF. Ajani's Chosen makes a 2/2 Cat when an enchantment ENTERS; the Sigil makes a 4/4 white Angel WITH FLYING when an enchantment is CAST. Twice the body, evasive, in a deck with 44 triggers. This also respects the lesson drain-v3 and drain-v4 both taught the hard way -- cutting a token-maker costs card draw, because this deck's draw runs through Enduring Curiosity on combat damage -- by replacing the bodies rather than deleting them.

EVERY ADD IS IN A BOX AND EVERY CUT IS ON THE BUY LIST, so this branch makes the deck cheaper as well as better. Transcendent Envoy discounts AURA spells in a list that runs four Auras.

TWO CARDS THE META RATES HIGHLY ARE DELIBERATELY HELD BACK, because this harness cannot see either and including them would corrupt the reading. EXTINGUISH ALL HOPE (55.0%, and already in a box) destroys all NONENCHANTMENT creatures -- a one-sided board wipe for a deck whose entire board is enchantment creatures -- and the goldfish models no opponents and no removal, so it is worth exactly zero here. SOARING LIGHTBRINGER (63.9%, syn +0.60) grants flying to other enchantment creatures and makes attacking 1/1 Glimmer ENCHANTMENT tokens that take the commander's grant, and evasion is likewise invisible to a model with no blockers. Both belong in a Forge run, not in this measurement.
